verdict.rationale: Bland documents high-volume batch call campaigns via CSV upload (bland-docs-6), dedicated per-customer enterprise compute and containers (bland-docs-36), and positions itself for high-volume phone workflows (bland-probe-1). That suggests it can handle scale, but the pack never states actual concurrency limits or self-serve scaling, and the dedicated capacity appears tied to enterprise contracts. Missing for 10: documented concurrent-call limits per plan, self-serve way to raise limits without contacting sales, and independent or hands-on evidence of many simultaneous calls at scale.
